title: Chibi spell cast
prompt_en: Anime chibi style, 16:9. A small wizard character waves a wand, glowing sparkles spiral out and form a star above its head. Bright colors, thick outlines, playful bouncy motion, simple forest background.
prompt_zh: Q版动画风格，16:9。小巫师角色挥动魔杖，发光的星光螺旋飞出，在头顶形成一颗星星。明亮色彩，粗轮廓线，俏皮弹跳的动作，简单的森林背景。
why_it_works: Simple shapes and thick outlines keep chibi characters stable across frames.
